summary: Three research-backed techniques from 2025-2026 literature to push Brier from 0.222 toward 0.218 target. Sources: MDPI Information Jan 2026 (NBA XGBoost+calibration → Brier ~0.20), Scientific Reports 2025 (stacked ensemble SHAP analysis), arXiv 2508.02725 Aug 2025 (Brier-loss custom objective).

techniques.name: Post-hoc Isotonic Calibration (CalibratedClassifierCV)
techniques.impact: HIGH — 0.005 to 0.010 Brier reduction, confirmed on NBA 2024 data
techniques.source: MDPI Information 17(1):56, January 2026 — XGBoost + calibration → Brier ~0.20 vs uncalibrated ~0.23

implementation.what: Wrap each GA-evolved model in sklearn.calibration.CalibratedClassifierCV before scoring
implementation.code_sketch:
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
cal_model = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_model, cv=5, method='isotonic')
cal_model.fit(X_calib, y_calib)
brier = brier_score_loss(y_val, cal_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:,1])
implementation.where: hf-space/app.py — in _evaluate_individual() after model.fit(). Use chronologically ordered train/calib/val split (no leakage).
implementation.caution: Use isotonic (not sigmoid) only when calibration set >= 2000 samples. With smaller sets use sigmoid (Platt scaling).
implementation.ga_integration: Add calibration_method as a GA hyperparameter: ['none', 'isotonic', 'sigmoid']. Let selection pressure find the best.

techniques.already_in_use: S13 uses Venn-Abers on best individual (Brier 0.22644 for 32f catboost). Generalize across all models.

techniques.name: LightGBM Custom Brier-Loss Objective
techniques.impact: MEDIUM — 0.003 to 0.008 Brier reduction, proven on NCAA basketball (arXiv 2508.02725)
techniques.source: arXiv 2508.02725 Aug 2025 — LSTM trained with Brier loss: 0.1589 vs BCE baseline 0.1748 (same architecture)

implementation.what: Replace log-loss objective in LightGBM with custom Brier-score objective
implementation.code_sketch:
def brier_obj(preds, train_data):
    labels = train_data.get_label()
    p = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-preds))  # sigmoid
    grad = 2.0 * (p - labels) * p * (1.0 - p)
    hess = 2.0 * p * (1.0 - p) * (p * (1.0 - p) + (p - labels) * (1.0 - 2.0 * p))
    return grad, hess
lgb.train(params, train_data, fobj=brier_obj)
implementation.where: hf-space/app.py — in _build_model() for LightGBM branch. Add loss_function hyperparameter ['logloss', 'brier'] to GA search space.
implementation.caution: Custom Brier objective converges 30-40% slower. Increase n_estimators proportionally. Monitor training loss carefully.

additional_finding.name: ECE as 4th Pareto Objective
additional_finding.impact: LOW-MEDIUM — improves betting calibration in specific probability bins
additional_finding.description: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) measures reliability across probability bins. Models with low Brier but high ECE are miscalibrated in specific ranges, killing Kelly betting even if aggregate Brier looks good. Add ECE as 4th NSGA-II objective alongside Brier, ROI, Sharpe.
